items.description: A conic gradient sweeps clockwise from the top, filling the box like a radar scan over ~700ms. The check mark appears once the sweep completes. Driven by a requestAnimationFrame loop.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-raised
items.title: Raised checkbox
items.description: The checked state looks physically raised off the surface. A sphere-like radial gradient (silver → dark gray) combined with six layered box-shadows (rim highlight, outer glow, ground lift shadow, inner top shine, inner bottom depth) creates a convincing 3D embossed button. The box also lifts 1px on the Y axis. Flat and recessed when unchecked.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-retro-led
items.title: Retro LED checkbox
items.description: The box interior is a 5×5 dot matrix. On check, white LEDs light up in a staggered sequence that traces a check-mark pattern through the grid. Off state: all dots dim. Retro display aesthetic.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-ripple-fill
items.title: Ripple Fill checkbox
items.description: A circular gray fill expands from the center outward via clip-path circle animation, like a water-drop ripple filling the box. The check mark fades in after the fill completes.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-round-morph
items.title: Round Morph checkbox
items.description: The checkbox shape morphs from a rounded square (7px radius) to a perfect circle on check via animated border-radius with a spring overshoot. Clean and satisfying shape transformation.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-scratch
items.title: Scratch checkbox
items.description: A diagonal clip-path wipe reveals the filled checked state from the bottom-right corner, like scratching a lottery card. Unchecking collapses the fill back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-shake-lock
items.title: Shake Lock checkbox
items.description: The box rattles in a rapid X-axis jitter sequence as if locking in, then snaps to the checked silver fill. Unchecking plays a shorter reverse shake. Kinetic, mechanical feel.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-shutter
items.title: Shutter checkbox
items.description: The checked fill opens like a camera iris/shutter using clip-path polygon animation: panels spread outward from a collapsed line to full coverage. Sharp, mechanical feel.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-spark-trail
items.title: Spark Trail checkbox
items.description: On check, 8 short white spark-streaks shoot outward in all directions and fade quickly, like an electric discharge. More energy-focused and rapid than confetti: pure white, no color variation.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-stamp
items.title: Stamp checkbox
items.description: The check mark crashes down from above like a rubber stamp, with a blur-to-focus motion and six ink-splatter dots radiating outward on impact. Dramatic and tactile.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-tilt-hover
items.title: Tilt Hover checkbox
items.description: On hover, the box tilts in 3D perspective (rotateX + rotateY) giving depth and a subtle lift shadow. Clicking snaps it flat and fills with mid-gray. The tilt resets once checked.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: checkbox-x-to-check
items.title: X to Check checkbox
items.description: Both states have visible content: unchecked shows a dim × (reject), checked shows a ✓ on a solid fill (approve). The × rotates away as the ✓ rotates in. The box shifts from faint to solid. A clear reject→approve narrative.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-card-number
items.title: Card number input
items.description: A card payment field: digits drop onto the card face in groups of four as you type, and the card turns over to its signature strip while you enter the security code.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-dial-time
items.title: Dial time input
items.description: A pickup time field: type a 24-hour time and the clock beside it sweeps its hands round to the time with a little overshoot, and says whether it is morning, afternoon or night.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-haiku
items.title: Haiku input
items.description: A haiku field in three lines with syllable beads beside each one that fill as you write five, seven and five; go over and the extra shows, and get all three right for a seal to stamp down.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-match
items.title: Match input
items.description: A confirm password pair: beads between the two fields light and link up as each character of the confirmation matches, shake at the first wrong one, and close into a chain when they all match.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-monogram
items.title: Monogram input
items.description: An engraving name field: as you type your name, your initials set themselves into an interlocked monogram in the crest above, the second letter in italic, each rising out of a blur.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-overflow
items.title: Overflow input
items.description: A short bio field with a limit: letters past it sag off the end of the line, each a little lower than the last, struck through as if spilling over, and the count turns into how many too many.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-pin-drop
items.title: Pin drop input
items.description: A meeting place field: type a city and once it can only be one place, a pin drops onto a dotted world map where it is, a ripple rings out and the country appears in the field.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-postal
items.title: Postal input
items.description: A postcode field drawn as postage stamps: each character is stamped into its own perforated stamp at a slight angle, and the row is franked with wavy lines once it is complete.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-quill
items.title: Quill input
items.description: A dedication field written with a quill: the quill rides the end of your words, fresh letters land in wet ink that blooms and then dries, and every few words it dips back in the pot.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-scrub
items.title: Scrub input
items.description: A number field you can drag: pull sideways on its label and a ruler slides under the value as it scrubs, Shift for steps of ten; or type, or use the arrow keys.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-angle
items.title: Angle input
items.description: A dial for gradient angles: drag round the ring and the hand follows, pulling toward each 45-degree mark (Shift snaps to 15), the nearest tick lights, and the number field and a live gradient swatch follow.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-calc
items.title: Calc input
items.description: An amount field that does arithmetic: type a sum and the total rolls in beside it digit by digit; Enter swaps the total in with a flash and keeps the sum it came from as a note below.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-cipher
items.title: Cipher input
items.description: A password field where every character scrambles through glyphs for a moment before it settles into a dot. Show decodes them all in a wave into the real characters; Hide scrambles them back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-combination
items.title: Combination input
items.description: A safe dial: spin it by dragging round, scrolling with the arrow keys, read the number under the marker, and enter three numbers in turn. When all three are set, the bolt slides open.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-constellation
items.title: Constellation input
items.description: Make a wish: every letter you type becomes a star in the night sky above the field, joined to the previous one by a line that draws in, and the whole figure glides to stay centred as it grows.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-convert
items.title: Convert input
items.description: A unit converter in one field: type a value with a unit (km, mi, m, ft, kg, g, lb, °C, °F) and every conversion in that family appears below, each number counting to its new value as you edit.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-date-range
items.title: Date Range input
items.description: A stay-dates calendar: pick a first night and a band previews the stay as you hover, then pick the last night and the band settles, gliding across each week row to join the two days.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-detent
items.title: Detent input
items.description: A size slider with detents: the thumb drags sticky against each stop and quick between them, clicks into place with a ring at each new size, and springs onto the nearest stop when you let go.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-domain
items.title: Domain input
items.description: An email field that finishes the domain for you: after the @ it ghost-completes the likeliest domain, the arrow keys cycle through the alternatives, and Tab accepts with a sweep under the field. A tick draws in once the address is valid.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-drum
items.title: Drum input
items.description: An alarm-time picker made of 3D drums: hour, minute and AM/PM wheels you drag, scroll or arrow through. The numbers sit round real cylinders that turn under a raised lens and snap to the nearest row.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-elastic
items.title: Elastic input
items.description: A volume slider with rubber-band ends: pull past either end and the track stretches and thins with growing resistance, then snaps back with a wobble. The thumb squashes with your speed and the value bubble leans with it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-extrude
items.title: Extrude input
items.description: A headline field that renders your text as solid 3D type above it: the extrusion turns to face the pointer, swaying gently on its own when you are elsewhere, and each new letter pops out of the depth.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-flapboard
items.title: Flapboard input
items.description: Type a destination and a split-flap departure board rolls every cell through the alphabet to the new letters, one flap at a time, with the status reading Updating until the board settles.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-gravity
items.title: Gravity input
items.description: A caption field where deleted text does not just vanish: every letter you delete drops out of the field and tumbles away with its own spin and drift, fading as it falls.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-grow
items.title: Grow input
items.description: A code-snippet field that grows line by line: the box springs taller as you add lines (up to seven, then scrolls), line numbers slide into the gutter, the current line's number lights and the footer tracks line and character counts.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-heat
items.title: Heat input
items.description: A message field that heats up with your typing speed: letters typed fast come out glowing hot and lifted, then cool to the normal colour over a couple of seconds, and a meter shows your words per minute.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-histogram
items.title: Histogram input
items.description: A price-range slider over the distribution of prices: bars grow in on load, the bars inside the chosen range light up, the selection line follows the two thumbs and the product count rolls to the new total.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-ink
items.title: Ink input
items.description: A dedication card where every letter bleeds onto the paper like ink: it lands blurred and slightly large, sharpens as it dries, and leaves a small blot spreading out beneath it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-mask
items.title: Mask input
items.description: A phone field with its format printed in place: digits drop into the slots of +1 (___) ___-____ as you type, the remaining slots stay faint, and a tick draws in once it is complete.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-measure
items.title: Measure input
items.description: A blueprint title field: your text sits on a grid between baseline and cap-height guides, and a dimension line with end ticks measures its real width in pixels, the number counting as it changes.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-mood
items.title: Mood input
items.description: A rating slider with a face: drag it and the mouth bends from a frown to a grin, the brows tilt, the eyes open wider and the cheeks blush as the mood rises, with the word flipping above. The face blinks now and then.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-natural-date
items.title: Natural Date input
items.description: A reminder field that reads plain language: write "next fri 3pm", "tomorrow 9am" or "in 3 days" and a calendar chip flips in with the exact date, time and how long until then.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-query
items.title: Query input
items.description: A search field that understands filters: tag:, by:, is: and type: tokens become pills as you type them, -words are struck through, quoted phrases are marked, and a dropdown suggests keys and then their values.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-redact
items.title: Redact input
items.description: A notes field that hides private details as you type: phone numbers and email addresses get a solid redaction bar wiped over them. Reveal wipes the bars off to an underline; Hide wipes them back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-rotary
items.title: Rotary input
items.description: Dial a number on a rotary phone: drag a finger hole clockwise to the stop and let go, and the disc springs back at a steady speed while the digit is added. Typing digits in the field dials them too.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-scramble
items.title: Scramble input
items.description: A PIN pad whose keys glide to new places after every press, so the pattern of taps gives nothing away. Four dots fill as you go, and a full PIN shakes the dots and resets.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-shell
items.title: Shell input
items.description: A tiny terminal: type commands like help, ls, date, whoami, echo or theme and the output slides up, Tab completes a command name shown as a ghost, the arrows recall history and clear wipes the screen.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-signature
items.title: Signature input
items.description: A signature pad with real ink: strokes thin out when you move fast and pool when you slow down, smoothed into curves. Type your name instead and it is set in a script face on the line; Clear starts over.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-slug
items.title: Slug input
items.description: A post-title field that builds its URL slug live underneath: accents are stripped, symbols become dashes, and each character of the slug pops in only when it actually changes. Copy puts the full link on the clipboard.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-tally
items.title: Tally input
items.description: A lap counter that keeps tally marks: tap the board and a hand-drawn stroke draws in, four uprights and then a slash across them for every five, while the count rolls up. Undo takes the last one back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-telegraph
items.title: Telegraph input
items.description: A message field you key in Morse: tap the brass key for a dot or hold it for a dash, a lamp lights while it is down, the tape records each symbol, and pauses decode them into letters and spaces.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-typewriter
items.title: Typewriter input
items.description: A note field that types like a typewriter: each key strikes the paper with its own slight tilt and ink density, the carriage slides the line along so the type always lands at the strike point, and a bell dings every twenty characters.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-url
items.title: URL input
items.description: Paste a link and it breaks down below into chips: a lock for secure, the host highlighted, every path segment, and each query parameter as a key and value, each chip popping in one after another.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-wave
items.title: Wave input
items.description: A caption field whose letters ride a travelling wave while it is focused; on blur the wave calms smoothly to a flat line, and new letters fade in on the swell.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-xy-pad
items.title: XY Pad input
items.description: Two values on one pad, like a synth filter: drag the puck and it follows with a little lag, leaving a fading trail, with crosshairs through it and both values read out above.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-caret
items.title: Smooth Caret input
items.description: The text caret glides instead of jumping. Every move (typing, arrow keys, clicking, Home and End) slides a custom caret to its new place and leaves a short comet streak behind it that fades; it blinks only once it is resting. Selections fall back to the native highlight.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-chips
items.title: Tag Chips input
items.description: A tag field. Press Enter or type a comma and the words you typed turn into a chip right where they were while the cursor glides along; Backspace on an empty field melts the last chip back into editable text. Repeats nudge the existing chip instead of doubling it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-code-slots
items.title: Code Slots input
items.description: A one-time code field drawn as six cells. Digits roll up into their cell and a caret blinks in the next one; when the sixth lands, the cells slide together into one pill and a tick pops beside it. One real input underneath, so paste and SMS autofill just work.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-composer
items.title: Composer input
items.description: A chat composer. The box springs taller line by line as you write (up to a limit, then it scrolls) with the send button riding its bottom edge; the button wakes up as soon as there is text, and sending lifts the message out of the box into the thread above as the box springs back to one line.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-drop
items.title: Drop Letters input
items.description: Every letter you type drops into the field from above with a little tumble and bounce, and letters you delete fall out through the floor. A real input keeps the caret, selection and typing; a mirror line draws the letters over it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-ghost
items.title: Ghost Complete input
items.description: An email field that finishes the domain for you. Type the @ and the rest of a likely address appears in grey after your caret with a Tab key hint; Tab (or the right arrow, or tapping the hint) washes the ghost text solid and it becomes part of what you typed.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-handle
items.title: Handle Check input
items.description: A username field that checks availability as you type. Characters a handle cannot use are refused with a nudge; three dots bounce while it looks (debounced, so only the name you stop on is checked); then a tick draws for a free name, or a cross pops for a taken one and free alternatives slide in underneath, ready to tap.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-lens
items.title: Lens Search input
items.description: Search that starts as a magnifying glass. Focusing it stretches the glass's ring sideways into the field itself while the handle tucks away and a small lens settles inside; empty it and click away and it shrinks back into the glass. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-odometer
items.title: Odometer input
items.description: A number stepper whose digits are mechanical wheels: each one rolls to its new figure (the tens wheel slides in and out as it is needed), and you can step with the buttons, the arrow keys, or by dragging the number sideways to scrub. Pushing past a limit bumps against it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-peek
items.title: Peek input
items.description: A password field whose show/hide toggle is a living eye. Hidden, the eye is shut; showing the password blinks it open, and while it is open the pupil follows your caret along the text.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-aurora
items.title: Aurora input
items.description: Blurred bands of light drift around the input on focus: a conic gradient whose start angle rotates via an animated @property. When unfocused, the glow fades out.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-border-draw
items.title: Border Draw input
items.description: On focus, four border lines trace around the input clockwise (top, right, bottom, left), each starting after the previous finishes. Pure CSS transforms, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-brutalist
items.title: Brutalist input
items.description: Neo-brutalist style: on focus a hard 4px offset black box-shadow slams from an offset position to zero, while the border snaps to high-contrast. Snappy cubic-bezier easing.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-count
items.title: Count input
items.description: A character counter and progress bar slide in below the input on first focus or keystroke. The counter and bar color shift from dim → light gray → white as the character limit approaches. Both slide away again when the field is empty and blurred.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-count-ring
items.title: Count Ring input
items.description: An SVG circular ring fills via stroke-dashoffset around a character count badge as the user approaches the limit. The ring brightens from mid-gray to white near the maximum.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-electric
items.title: Electric input
items.description: An SVG overlay traces an electric arc around the input border via stroke-dashoffset animation on focus. White neon sparking effect that completes a full perimeter trace.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-fill
items.title: Fill input
items.description: On focus, a tinted background layer scales from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) with transformOrigin left, flooding the input with color from left to right. Border color transitions simultaneously. Pure transform, no opacity flash.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-float-label
items.title: Float Label input
items.description: The label lives inside the field at rest and floats above the text on focus or when a value is present. Pure CSS transitions, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-frosted
items.title: Frosted input
items.description: On focus, the input transitions to a frosted glass look: backdrop-filter blur increases and the background shifts to semi-transparent white. Clean glassmorphism aesthetic.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-glitch-error
items.title: Glitch Error input
items.description: On failed validation the input briefly glitches (a CSS invert/brightness flicker plus translateX jitter keyframe over 500ms), then snaps to a bright border. Unsettling, memorable error feedback.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-glow
items.title: Glow input
items.description: On focus the border lights up and a soft halo radiates outward via box-shadow. Pure CSS transitions, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-gradient-ring
items.title: Gradient Ring input
items.description: On focus a conic-gradient border continuously rotates around the input using a @property CSS custom property (--gr-angle) animated from 0deg to 360deg. The ring fades in with opacity and fades out on blur.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-gradient-spin
items.title: Gradient Spin input
items.description: A conic-gradient border rotates continuously while the input is focused, achieved by spinning a larger gradient square behind a clipped wrapper to simulate an animated gradient border.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-hud-brackets
items.title: HUD Brackets input
items.description: Four L-shaped corner brackets animate inward on focus, locking the input in a targeting-reticle frame. Sci-fi HUD aesthetic.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-icon-shift
items.title: Icon Shift input
items.description: A leading icon rotates and shifts on focus with a spring overshoot, while the border glows and a box-shadow ring appears. The icon color transitions from muted to accent, giving the field a lively focused state.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-laser
items.title: Laser input
items.description: On focus a white laser beam sweeps left-to-right along the bottom border via scaleX keyframe (300ms), leaving a persistent glowing hairline underline.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-liquid-fill
items.title: Liquid Fill input
items.description: An animated liquid wave rises from the bottom of the input via clip-path polygon updated by requestAnimationFrame on focus. The wave oscillates continuously while focused.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-magnetic-label
items.title: Magnetic Label input
items.description: The label springs from center-left into the top-left corner of the input on focus using Framer Motion layout animation. Springs back on blur if the field is empty.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-morph-shape
items.title: Morph Shape input
items.description: Border-radius morphs through a personality arc on focus: sharp (2px) → pill (50px) → settled rounded (10px), played with the Web Animations API so typing is never interrupted.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-neon-pulse
items.title: Neon Pulse input
items.description: A neon glow box-shadow breathes in and out on a looping CSS keyframe while the input is focused. Sci-fi terminal aesthetic in glowing grays.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-neumorphic
items.title: Neumorphic input
items.description: Outer raised dual-shadow transitions to an inset pressed dual-shadow on focus, making the input appear to sink into the soft surface. Smooth 250ms transition.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-particle-burst
items.title: Particle Burst input
items.description: Small particles burst outward from the input corners on focus via absolutely positioned spans with staggered CSS animations. A festive, energetic focus confirmation.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-progress-fill
items.title: Progress Fill input
items.description: The input background fills left-to-right proportional to the typed character count relative to a target length. A calm, satisfying completion indicator with smooth transitions.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-ripple-type
items.title: Ripple Type input
items.description: Each keystroke triggers a brief border-color ripple pulse on the input via a CSS keyframe that spikes to accent then settles back. The input visually feels each character typed.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-scan-line
items.title: Scan Line input
items.description: A horizontal scan line sweeps top-to-bottom through the focused input continuously on a ~2s CSS keyframe loop. Futuristic active-state ambient indicator.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-shake
items.title: Shake input
items.description: On invalid submission the input rattles horizontally to signal an error: a rapidly damping shake with a bright border. Pure CSS keyframes, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-split
items.title: Split input
items.description: Two opaque panels cover the input at rest like sliding doors. On focus they translate outward (left panel slides left, right panel slides right), revealing a gradient background underneath. A sharp cubic-bezier gives the reveal a decisive, mechanical feel.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-split-label
items.title: Split Label input
items.description: A floating label that splits into its words: on focus each word rises above the field and shrinks on its own, staggered left to right, then drops back in reverse when the field is cleared.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-spotlight
items.title: Spotlight input
items.description: A radial gradient spotlight follows the cursor horizontally inside the input as the user mouses over it, creating a torch-light illumination effect within the field.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-strength
items.title: Strength input
items.description: A password strength meter: a segmented bar below the input fills and brightens from dark gray to near-white as the user types, driven by character analysis.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-tag-label
items.title: Tag Label input
items.description: On focus the label slides upward and a light pill badge background expands behind it via scaleX. The label transforms from a plain hint into a bold field identifier tag.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-typeout
items.title: Typeout input
items.description: A custom placeholder types itself out character-by-character on mount at 60ms per character. When focused, it instantly clears so the user can type freely.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-underline
items.title: Underline input
items.description: Minimal borderless input: a bright line draws from left to right under the field on focus. Pure CSS transform, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-validate
items.title: Validate input
items.description: A right-side icon morphs between states: invisible on idle, a checkmark springs in on valid email format, an X shakes in on invalid submission attempt.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: input-wobble
items.title: Wobble input
items.description: On focus the input jiggles with a CSS keyframe combining rotation and translateX zigzag over 400ms then settles. Playful tactile feedback.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-ampersand
items.title: Ampersand loader
items.description: An ampersand written in one unbroken stroke behind a glowing nib, held for a moment, then wiped away from where it began.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-beacon
items.title: Beacon loader
items.description: A lighthouse on its rock: the beam sweeps round, narrowing and flaring as it faces you, then swings out the other side, over a slow rolling sea.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-brew
items.title: Brew loader
items.description: A cup of coffee on its saucer with three threads of steam curling up and thinning out, each on its own rhythm.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-fireflies
items.title: Fireflies loader
items.description: Seven fireflies drifting on their own slow paths and blinking in turn, each with a different pace and rhythm.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-grid-wave
items.title: Grid wave loader
items.description: A five by five grid of dots with a ripple running through it from corner to corner, each dot swelling, brightening and settling as it passes.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-loom
items.title: Loom loader
items.description: A loom weaving: a shuttle carries the weft over and under the warp threads, row by row and back again, until the cloth is woven, then it is cleared and begins again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-lunar
items.title: Lunar loader
items.description: The moon running through its phases, new to full and back to new, with a true curved terminator and faint craters showing through.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-pages
items.title: Pages loader
items.description: An open book whose pages turn over one after another, each brightening as it lifts past the spine and settling on the left.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-seam
items.title: Seam loader
items.description: A needle sews a line of stitches round a rounded square of cloth with the thread following it, then the seam is pulled away and it starts again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-sundial
items.title: Sundial loader
items.description: The sun arcs over a sundial and the gnomon's shadow sweeps across the hours, long in the morning, short at noon and long again by evening.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-assemble
items.title: Assemble loader
items.description: Sixteen scattered particles fly in from all sides and lock together into a block, the block turns a quarter, then bursts apart in new directions and gathers again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-binary
items.title: Binary loader
items.description: A byte counting up in lit bits, nibble by nibble, with its hex and decimal value counting beside it. It wraps from 255 back to zero and keeps going.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-binary-star
items.title: Binary Star loader
items.description: Two stars of different sizes orbit their shared centre with comet trails behind them, while a small planet circles both on a wider, slower path.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-coil
items.title: Coil loader
items.description: A weight bobs on a spring hanging from a bar. The coil stretches open as the weight drops and bunches tight as it rises, with the back half of every turn drawn dimmer so it reads as a helix.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-conveyor
items.title: Conveyor loader
items.description: Parcels ride a moving belt over turning rollers, then tip over the end and drop off, one after another.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-droplet
items.title: Droplet loader
items.description: A drop falls, stretching as it speeds up, splashes a crown of beads up off the surface and sends two ripples spreading outward.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-event-horizon
items.title: Event Horizon loader
items.description: A black hole: a spinning accretion disc passes in front of the hole, and light from the disc's far side is lensed into a glowing ring arching up and over it, flickering softly.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-flask
items.title: Flask loader
items.description: A round-bottom flask fills with a sloshing liquid as bubbles rise through it, holds full for a moment, then drains, over and over.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-fold
items.title: Fold loader
items.description: A square of paper folds in half from the bottom, then in half again from the right, holds, and opens back out, with each flap shading darker as it turns away from the light.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-fractal
items.title: Fractal loader
items.description: A Sierpinski triangle of 27 cells that light up in a wave running through the recursion order, corner by corner, then dim back down, over and over.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-galaxy
items.title: Galaxy loader
items.description: Two spiral arms of twinkling stars wheel slowly round a glowing core, the outer stars smaller and fainter.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-globe
items.title: Globe loader
items.description: A wireframe planet of meridians and latitude rings spinning in 3D, with a satellite on a tilted orbit circling it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-hive
items.title: Hive loader
items.description: Seven hexagon cells of a honeycomb: the six outer cells light round the comb in turn while the core pulses at twice the pace.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-kaleidoscope
items.title: Kaleidoscope loader
items.description: A turning kaleidoscope: three drifting shapes in one wedge are mirrored into six, so they meet and part in symmetric patterns while the whole disc slowly rotates.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-line-clear
items.title: Line Clear loader
items.description: A tiny falling-block game: pieces drop and settle until the bottom rows are complete, the rows flash and clear, and the board starts again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-maze
items.title: Maze loader
items.description: A generated maze solves itself: the route draws from the entrance in the top corner to the exit in the bottom one, the goal flashes as it arrives, and the line fades before solving again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-metronome
items.title: Metronome loader
items.description: A metronome: the weighted arm swings across its scale and a light flashes at each end of the arc, exactly on the beat.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-mobius
items.title: Mobius loader
items.description: A Mobius band built from slices: each one is twisted by half its angle round the loop, so the band carries a single half twist. The slices roll round their own loop endlessly while the whole band turns slowly in 3D.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-odometer
items.title: Odometer loader
items.description: Rolling digit reels count from 000 to 100 percent in uneven jumps, like a real transfer; each reel rolls forward through its digits with a little bounce, then the count holds and starts over.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-paper-plane
items.title: Paper Plane loader
items.description: A paper plane loops the loop along a dotted flight path, banking to follow every curve, then flies out and round again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-pendulum-wave
items.title: Pendulum Wave loader
items.description: A pendulum wave seen from above: twelve bobs swing at slightly different periods, so they fall in and out of step, forming snakes, travelling waves and apparent chaos before lining up in unison again every twelve seconds.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-percent
items.title: Percent loader
items.description: A progress ring with a percentage that loads the way real progress feels: a quick start, a long slow middle, a stall near the end, then the last stretch at once, a tick, and round again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-pixel-spinner
items.title: Pixel Spinner loader
items.description: A chunky 8-bit spinner: a ring of square pixels with a bright segment and a fading tail stepping round it, one pixel at a time.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-plasma-globe
items.title: Plasma Globe loader
items.description: A plasma globe: live filaments crawl from the glowing electrode out to the glass, each wandering and flickering, their feet drifting slowly round the sphere where they strike it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-rally
items.title: Rally loader
items.description: Two paddles keep a ball in play across a dashed net, like the first video game: the ball bounces off the walls, picks up a little spin off each paddle, and each paddle tracks it only while it is coming its way.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-ripple-field
items.title: Ripple Field loader
items.description: A 9x9 field of dots with ripples spreading outward from the centre, each dot swelling and brightening as a wavefront passes.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-scanner
items.title: Scanner loader
items.description: A barcode scanner: a laser line sweeps up and down the code while a band of light travels with it, lighting each bar it crosses.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-signal
items.title: Signal loader
items.description: A wireless signal: the source lights first, then each arc outward in turn, all hold, then go dark together and start again.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-slide-puzzle
items.title: Slide Puzzle loader
items.description: A 3x3 sliding puzzle where the gap walks round the edge forever, so the ring of tiles keeps rotating with a springy slide, the bright key tile riding round with them.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-sound-ring
items.title: Sound Ring loader
items.description: A circular spectrum: forty bars round a ring pump to their own beats in clusters, like frequency bands, while the whole ring turns slowly.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-terrain
items.title: Terrain loader
items.description: A plane of dots seen in perspective rolls with crossing waves, the crests rising and brightening, like a landscape breathing.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-tesseract
items.title: Tesseract loader
items.description: A four-dimensional cube, a tesseract, turning through the fourth axis and projected down to a wireframe. The inner and outer cubes swap places endlessly while the whole shadow drifts, and the cube nearer in 4D is drawn brighter.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-torus
items.title: Torus loader
items.description: A torus made of 300 points tumbling in 3D: it spins round its own axis so the points flow round the ring, rocks and sways, and the near side glows larger and brighter while the far side falls away.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-tunnel
items.title: Tunnel loader
items.description: Rounded frames rush out of a point of light at the centre, twisting as they come, like flying down a wormhole.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-vortex
items.title: Vortex loader
items.description: Particles spiral in from the rim of a vortex, slow at the edge and whipping round faster as they fall toward a pulsing dark core.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-atom
items.title: Atom loader
items.description: A glowing nucleus with three electrons on orbits tilted 60 degrees apart, each racing round its own ellipse at a different speed. The orbits are rotated boxes and each electron rides an elliptical offset-path inside its own. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-battery
items.title: Battery loader
items.description: A battery charging: its four cells light one at a time with a hard step, then the full battery blinks twice and drains to start again. A bolt is cut into the fill, so it only shows through where the cells are lit. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-clock
items.title: Clock loader
items.description: A small clock face with twelve ticks: the minute hand sweeps round once a beat while the hour hand creeps along at a twelfth of the speed, so time visibly passes while you wait. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-cradle
items.title: Newton's Cradle loader
items.description: Five balls hanging from a bar on strings. The end ball swings out and falls back; the knock travels through the still middle three and kicks the far ball out, and back again, with easing that slows at the top of each swing like a real pendulum. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-dominoes
items.title: Dominoes loader
items.description: Seven dominoes topple in a chain, each falling faster as it goes and coming to rest leaning on the next (the last one falls flat), then they stand back up one by one in the same order. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-eclipse
items.title: Eclipse loader
items.description: A solar eclipse on loop: the moon slides across the sun, slowing as it covers it, and at totality the corona flares out around the black disc before the moon drifts on and the sun returns. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-gears
items.title: Gears loader
items.description: Two meshed gears, ten teeth and seven, turning against each other at the right ratio (the small one 10/7 as fast) so the teeth stay engaged all the way round. The tooth outlines are generated from real gear geometry. Pure CSS rotation.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-heartbeat
items.title: Heartbeat loader
items.description: A heart monitor: a bright trace with a fading tail runs across the screen through a spike, led by a glowing dot that rides the same line, and fades out at the edges before coming round again. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-hourglass
items.title: Hourglass loader
items.description: An hourglass: sand drains from the top bulb in a thin stream and piles up in the bottom one, then the glass flips over with a little overshoot and it starts again. The flip lands on the exact frame the loop restarts on, so it never jumps. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-infinity
items.title: Infinity loader
items.description: A bright streak with a fading tail races endlessly round a figure-eight track, crossing itself in the middle. Two dash segments on the same SVG path, offset so the head always leads the tail. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-lava
items.title: Lava loader
items.description: A lava lamp. Blobs of wax drift up from a warm pool at the bottom, stretch, pinch off and melt back into it, merging whenever they touch. The goo is a blur + contrast filter on the layer, so there is no SVG filter or id to collide. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-radar
items.title: Radar loader
items.description: A radar scope: a beam with a fading wake sweeps round the rings and crosshairs, and each blip flares exactly as the beam's leading edge passes over it, then fades until the next sweep. Each blip's delay is computed from its own angle. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-ring-text
items.title: Ring Text loader
items.description: LOADING · PLEASE WAIT set round a circle like a badge, turning slowly, while a bright highlight chases round the letters and a dot breathes in the middle. Each letter is a span placed by its index. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-segment
items.title: Segment loader
items.description: A seven-segment display digit where a lit segment chases a figure-eight round the 8 (top, right, middle, left, bottom, right, middle, left), leaving a glowing trail that fades behind it. The middle bar is visited twice per loop, so it has its own keyframes. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-snake
items.title: Snake loader
items.description: A five-segment snake slithers over a 4x4 grid of dots, cell by cell, weaving through every square on a closed path with its head brightest and its tail fading. Each segment rides the same offset-path with steps() timing, one cell behind the next. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-stack
items.title: Stack loader
items.description: Three blocks drop one after another onto a shelf and stack up, each landing with a squash and a little recoil, then the finished stack slides off and the next one starts. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-sunflower
items.title: Sunflower loader
items.description: Forty-eight dots laid out the way seeds pack in a sunflower head (each turned by the golden angle and pushed out by the square root of its index), with a wave of light pulsing out from the centre as the head turns slowly. The layout is CSS maths on one index per dot. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-terminal
items.title: Terminal loader
items.description: A tiny terminal window running an install: a braille spinner cycles through its ten frames beside a status line that rolls up through resolving, fetching, linking and building, then loops. Both are strips moved with steps() or held keyframes. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-tumble
items.title: Tumble loader
items.description: A block tumbles over and over along a dashed floor: it tips onto its next face about its leading corner and lands, again and again, while the floor slides back under it in step, so it rolls forever without leaving its spot. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-bounce-dots
items.title: Bounce Dots loader
items.description: Three dots that bounce vertically in sequence: the classic typing-indicator pattern. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-bouncing-ball
items.title: Bouncing Ball loader
items.description: A squash-and-stretch ball with a synced shadow: multi-stop keyframes fake physical bounce physics. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-color-bounce
items.title: Color Bounce loader
items.description: Five dots (each a step lighter than the last), bouncing vertically in a rolling wave. A tonalul take on the classic typing indicator. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-comet
items.title: Comet loader
items.description: A conic-gradient ring that spins like a comet tail: gray-to-white arc on a masked circle. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-dots-circle
items.title: Dots Circle loader
items.description: Eight dots arranged in a clock face, fading in and out in radial sequence: the classic OS-native loading indicator pattern. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-dual-ring
items.title: Dual Ring loader
items.description: Two concentric rings rotating in opposite directions at different speeds: bright outer ring clockwise, dimmer inner ring counter-clockwise. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-equalizer
items.title: Equalizer loader
items.description: Five bars each running an independent height animation at a different duration: the unsynchronized cadences create an organic music-equalizer feel. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-flip-square
items.title: Flip Square loader
items.description: A gradient rounded square continuously tumbling on its Y axis using CSS 3D perspective: a satisfying single-element loader. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-gradient-ring
items.title: Gradient Ring loader
items.description: A spinning ring with a light-to-dark conic gradient in one continuous arc. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-helix
items.title: Helix loader
items.description: Two dots oscillating vertically in opposite phase with scaleX depth: a DNA helix cross-section effect. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-morph
items.title: Morph loader
items.description: A single element that continuously morphs through three shapes (circle, blob, and square), while rotating and shifting color. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-mosaic
items.title: Mosaic loader
items.description: A 3×3 grid of grayscale tiles that pulse in and out with a ripple delay, creating a vibrant mosaic shimmer effect. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-neon-ripple
items.title: Neon Ripple loader
items.description: Three concentric light rings that expand outward from a glowing core dot. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-orbit
items.title: Orbit loader
items.description: A dot orbits a center point along a faint circular track. Pure CSS rotation, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar loader
items.description: An indeterminate progress bar: a gradient shimmer slides across a pill-shaped track from left to right on loop. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-pulse-dots
items.title: Pulse Dots loader
items.description: Three dots that scale and fade in a left-to-right wave. Staggered CSS keyframes, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-skeleton
items.title: Skeleton loader
items.description: A shimmer content placeholder: avatar, name, and body line shapes with a sweeping highlight. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-spinning-ring
items.title: Spinning Ring loader
items.description: A circular ring with a transparent track and a solid arc that spins continuously. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer loader
items.description: The word "Loading" rendered in uppercase with a bright spotlight sweeping across it via background-clip:text, a text-as-canvas shimmer effect. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: loader-wave-bars
items.title: Wave Bars loader
items.description: Five vertical bars in distinct colors that scale up and down in a rippling wave sequence. Pure CSS, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-capture
items.title: Capture radio button
items.description: A camera mode picker: the shutter button morphs between photo, record and portrait, video adds a blinking record tag and portrait melts the background behind the subject.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-crop
items.title: Crop radio button
items.description: An aspect ratio picker: choose 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9 and the crop frame reshapes over the photo with a little overshoot, dimming everything that falls outside it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-eq
items.title: EQ radio button
items.description: A sound picker drawn as an equaliser: choose warm, flat or bright and the curve and its fill bend smoothly into the new shape across the frequencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-focal
items.title: Focal radio button
items.description: A lens picker drawn from above: as the focal length goes up from 24 to 85 mm the field of view narrows from the camera, leaving fewer of the subjects inside it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-lux
items.title: Lux radio button
items.description: A light level picker drawn as a pendant lamp over a table: its beam and the pool of light on the table widen and brighten with each level.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-nib
items.title: Nib radio button
items.description: A nib size picker: choose fine, medium or broad and the pen signs the line again in that width, the nib riding the stroke from the first letter to the flourish.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-pace
items.title: Pace radio button
items.description: A pace picker: choose walk, jog or run and footprints appear along the trail, spaced further apart and coming faster at each pace.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-paper
items.title: Paper radio button
items.description: A paper size picker: choose A5, A4 or A3 and the sheet grows or shrinks against dashed outlines of the other sizes, with its size in millimetres underneath.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-roast
items.title: Roast radio button
items.description: A roast picker: choose light, medium or dark and the beans swell, oil comes up as a sheen and they crack once, twice or three times.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-specimen
items.title: Specimen radio button
items.description: A typeface picker: choose serif, sans or mono and the specimen dissolves and resolves in the new face, like a lens racking focus.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-altitude
items.title: Altitude radio button
items.description: Waypoints on a mountain: choose base, camp or summit and the climber follows the zigzag trail up or down to it, the walked trail drawing behind them, and the altitude rolls.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-aperture
items.title: Aperture radio button
items.description: An aperture picker: choose f/1.8, f/4 or f/11 and six iris blades turn in or out over the light, leaving a wide or a tiny hexagonal opening.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-bloom
items.title: Bloom radio button
items.description: A growth stage picker on a flower: from a closed bud the petals spread out to half open and then to a full flower, the outer ones last, and the centre grows and glows.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-brush
items.title: Brush radio button
items.description: A brush size picker: choose a size and the preview stroke is drawn again at the new width, with a ring for the brush tip tracing along it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-burner
items.title: Burner radio button
items.description: A gas burner: choose low, medium or high and the knob turns while the row of flickering flames drops low or roars up, the glow under them following.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-chart
items.title: Chart radio button
items.description: A chart type picker: from bar to line, the bars shrink into points at their own tops and a line draws through them; area then fills in under it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-chess
items.title: Chess radio button
items.description: A pawn promotion picker: choose queen, rook, bishop or knight and the piece drops onto the square with a flash.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-finish
items.title: Finish radio button
items.description: A paint finish picker on a sphere: matte spreads the highlight wide and soft, satin tightens it, and gloss sharpens it to a glint with a reflected window and a rim of light.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-flock
items.title: Flock radio button
items.description: A formation picker: seven flapping birds fly into a line, a V or a ring, one after another.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-floor
items.title: Floor radio button
items.description: Lift buttons as a radio group: press a floor and the doors close, the car rides up or down the shaft to it, and the doors open again; the pressed button lights.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-forecast
items.title: Forecast radio button
items.description: A forecast picker: sunny, cloudy or rain. A cloud rolls in over the turning sun, the sun hides behind it, rain starts to fall, and the temperature rolls to match.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-gear
items.title: Gear radio button
items.description: A gear selector for P, R, N and D: the knob clicks along the gate to the gear you pick with a little overshoot, and the display rolls to the new letter.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-grind
items.title: Grind radio button
items.description: A coffee grind picker: choose fine, medium or coarse and the crank turns, grounds pour from the chute, and the pile in the cup settles finer or coarser.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-hop
items.title: Hop radio button
items.description: A size picker where a ball hops tile to tile to the size you choose, one bounce for every tile it crosses, squashing as it lands on each.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-layers
items.title: Layers radio button
items.description: Map layers in a 3D stack: choose map, satellite or terrain and that layer rises to the top of the stack and lights, while the others settle beneath it.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-level
items.title: Level radio button
items.description: Audio balance as a spirit level: choose left, centre or right and the level tilts, while the bubble drifts to the high side, overshoots a little and settles like it is floating in liquid.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-metronome
items.title: Metronome radio button
items.description: A tempo picker on a metronome: choose largo, andante or presto and the weight slides along the arm while it swings at the new speed, with a light on every beat.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-order
items.title: Order radio button
items.description: A sort control: choose name, price or rating and the rows slide into the new order with a little spring, while the column you sorted by lights.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-phase
items.title: Phase radio button
items.description: A moon phase picker: choose new, crescent, gibbous or full and the shadow slides across the cratered moon while its glow grows towards full.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-plane
items.title: Plane radio button
items.description: A destination picker with a paper plane: choose a city and the plane flies to it in an arc, banking slightly, then hovers over it with a gentle bob.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-recline
items.title: Recline radio button
items.description: Cabin class as a seat: pick economy, premium or business and the seat reclines further for each, its legrest rising to match.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-resolution
items.title: Resolution radio button
items.description: A video quality picker: choose 240p, 720p or 4K and the picture breaks into blocks or sharpens, stepping through the resolutions in between.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-rock-paper
items.title: Rock Paper Scissors radio button
items.description: Rock, paper, scissors as a radio group: pick your move and the hand shakes twice, then throws it, fingers unfolding for paper and two of them spreading for scissors.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-route
items.title: Route radio button
items.description: A destination picker on a railway line: choose a station and the train pulls along the track to it, accelerating and braking in; the platform lamp and its name light as it arrives.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-seasons
items.title: Seasons radio button
items.description: A season picker on a tree: spring buds, full summer leaves, autumn leaves drifting down, then bare branches with snow on them and snow falling.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-slices
items.title: Slices radio button
items.description: A pizza slice picker: choose 4, 6 or 8 slices and the cuts swing round to their new angles, a new cut drawing in when one is needed.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-spice
items.title: Spice radio button
items.description: A heat level picker: mild, hot or fire light up one, two or three chillies in turn, heat shimmers rise above them, and at fire the chillies shake.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tickets
items.title: Tickets radio button
items.description: A ticket quantity picker: choose one to four and the tickets fan out from the stack, one more for each step, or fold back in.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tide
items.title: Tide radio button
items.description: A tide picker: choose low, mid or high and the sea slowly rises or falls against the marks on the pier, with the waves running and a buoy bobbing on top.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tone
items.title: Tone radio button
items.description: A message tone picker: formal, casual or playful. The speech bubble changes shape, from a squared card to a rounded pill to a tilted blob, and the message rewrites itself in that voice.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-traffic
items.title: Traffic radio button
items.description: A traffic light where each lamp is an option: choose stop, wait or go and that lamp lights at once, while the old one fades out slowly like a real bulb.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tuner
items.title: Tuner radio button
items.description: Station presets on an old radio dial: pick one and the needle sweeps along the FM band to its frequency, the stereo lamp drops out while it travels and flickers back on as it locks.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-wheel
items.title: Wheel radio button
items.description: A what's-for-dinner picker on a prize wheel: pick a dish and the wheel spins forward, always at least two turns, and slows to stop with it under the pointer, which ticks as it passes the segments.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-wind
items.title: Wind radio button
items.description: A wind picker on a windsock: calm leaves it hanging limp, a breeze lifts it halfway and a gale flies it straight out, fluttering faster as the wind grows while the grass leans.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-zoom
items.title: Zoom radio button
items.description: Focal lengths through a viewfinder: choose 24, 50 or 85 mm and the scene zooms in or out on the tree with a moment of focus breathing.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-align
items.title: Align radio button
items.description: Text alignment buttons above a paragraph of placeholder lines. Choosing left, centre or right slides every line across to its new edge one after another; justify stretches all but the last line to the full width. Pure CSS: each line knows its own width, and one --k (0, 0.5, 1) says how far across it goes.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-daylight
items.title: Daylight radio button
items.description: A time-of-day picker with a little sky. The sun rides an arc from sunrise to sunset to the option you choose while the sky brightens or dims; at night a shadow slides over it to make a crescent moon and the stars come out. Pure CSS (offset-path for the arc).
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-delivery
items.title: Delivery radio button
items.description: Shipping options with a little delivery truck on a one-week road above them. Choosing an option drives the truck to the day it would arrive (Tomorrow, 2 days, 5–7 days): its wheels spin and its body bobs while it drives, and it turns round when it has to go back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-dial
items.title: Dial radio button
items.description: A rotary knob like the one on a fan or an oven. The settings sit round its top arc with a tick each; choosing one (click, or the arrow keys) turns the ridged knob so its pointer swings to it with a mechanical overshoot. Real radios underneath. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-die
items.title: Die radio button
items.description: Pick a number and a 3D die rolls to it: it hops up, tumbles a full extra turn on its way to the chosen face and lands with a squash while its shadow shrinks and grows underneath. Each roll adds another turn (a tiny script), so it never just rotates back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-drum
items.title: Drum radio button
items.description: An iOS-style picker wheel built on a real radio group. The options sit round a 3D drum that turns to bring the chosen one into the lit band; spin it with the mouse wheel, drag it up and down, click an option, or use the arrow keys. The edges fade away like the curve of a real drum.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-fan
items.title: Fan radio button
items.description: Pick a card. Four playing cards are fanned out in a hand; hovering one nudges it up, and choosing it lifts it clear of the fan, straightens it and turns it face-lit while the rest stay tucked in. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-flip-card
items.title: Flip Card radio button
items.description: Plan cards that flip. Choosing one turns it over in 3D with a springy settle to reveal its lit back (a tick, the plan and "Selected"), while the card you had before flips back to its front. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-folders
items.title: Folders radio button
items.description: Three file folders stacked in a drawer, each with its tab at a different place along the top. Choosing a tab brings that folder to the front with a little lift and tips its front flap open in 3D to show the papers inside; the folder it replaces closes and drops back. Nothing rises above the bodies, so every tab stays in view. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-layout
items.title: Layout radio button
items.description: A view switcher (grid, list, feature) whose preview actually rearranges: the four tiles glide and resize into the new layout one after another with a springy settle, so you see what you are choosing. Pure CSS (each layout is a set of positions picked with :has()).
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-mood
items.title: Mood radio button
items.description: How was it? Five faces from a deep frown to a big grin. The chosen face springs up larger, fills in light with its features turning dark, and its mouth gives a little bounce while its name rises in underneath; the others stay small and dim. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-seat
items.title: Seat radio button
items.description: A tiny cinema seat map. Taken seats are crossed out and skipped by the arrow keys; picking a free seat lifts it with a pop and lights it, and the ticket below rolls its seat code over to the new one, like a departures board.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-shape
items.title: Shape radio button
items.description: A shape picker whose preview morphs: circle, square, triangle and star are all 20-point polygons drawn from the top clockwise, so choosing one melts the preview straight into the next with a springy overshoot. Pure CSS (clip-path interpolation).
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-sizes
items.title: Sizes radio button
items.description: A size picker that shows the size. Above the S, M, L, XL pills, a T-shirt springs bigger or smaller to match the one you choose, and the chest measurement under it updates. Pure CSS with :has().
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-stars
items.title: Stars radio button
items.description: A five-star rating that is a real radio group. Hovering previews the rating in grey; choosing fills the stars up to it in a quick left-to-right cascade with a springy pop on the one you picked, and a caption says what the score means. Pure CSS with :has().
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tab-bar
items.title: Tab Bar radio button
items.description: A bottom navigation bar as a radio group. The chosen tab's pill widens to make room for its label, which slides out from behind the icon while the icon fills in with a little bounce; the previous tab folds back to just its outline icon. Pure CSS (the label width animates through grid 0fr to 1fr).
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-theme
items.title: Theme radio button
items.description: A theme picker inside a preview panel. Choosing Light, Dim or Dark floods the panel with the new theme as a circle spreading out from the chip you picked, over the old theme, which stays put underneath until it is covered. Pure CSS: one layer per theme, stacked by z-index.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-tip-jar
items.title: Tip Jar radio button
items.description: A tip picker with a jar. Choosing 10, 15, 20 or 25% drops that many coins into the jar one after another, each tumbling in and landing on the pile with a little bounce; picking less sends the extras back up out of the top. The amount updates underneath. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-turntable
items.title: Turntable radio button
items.description: A record player speed switch: Off, 33, 45 or 78 rpm. The tone arm swings onto the record when it plays, and the record changes speed smoothly without ever jumping: three nested spinners (33, +12, +33 rpm) are paused or played, never restarted, so their speeds simply add up. Pure CSS.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-blob
items.title: Blob radio button
items.description: A liquid blob indicator morphs and slides between options using Framer Motion layoutId. The blob stretches horizontally during travel, then snaps back to a round pill shape, simulating organic liquid motion between selection points.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-bubble
items.title: Bubble radio button
items.description: A radio group with 30px spherical indicators that transform from a flat hollow ring into a 3D gel/bubble using a radial gradient highlight at the top-left and a specular gloss spot. Selected state glows with a soft white aura and inset shine.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-card
items.title: Card radio button
items.description: A radio group where each option is a full card row with a title and subtitle. Selecting a card reveals a light left-edge accent stripe via inset box-shadow, brightens the border and background, brightens the subtitle, and springs a small dot indicator. Ideal for plan/tier selectors.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-clay
items.title: Clay radio button
items.description: Soft clay morphing: selecting an option triggers a squish animation on the indicator dot (scaleX 1.3, scaleY 0.7 then spring back to 1,1), with a soft tonal fill and layered soft shadow. Feels like pressing a clay button.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-constellation
items.title: Constellation radio button
items.description: On selection, five star dots appear around the option with SVG connecting lines forming a mini constellation. Each star twinkles with a looping opacity animation. Feels like the option is cosmically chosen.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-cursor
items.title: Cursor radio button
items.description: A glowing gray pill indicator slides smoothly between selected options via translateY, acting like a cursor homing in on the active choice. Labels brighten on select; the pill springs with a cubic-bezier overshoot.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-elastic
items.title: Elastic radio button
items.description: A rubber-band selection pill stretches horizontally as it springs between options via Framer Motion layoutId with high-stiffness spring physics. The distortion gives a tactile elastic band feel to the transition.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-frost
items.title: Frost radio button
items.description: A frosted glass pill slides between options using Framer Motion layoutId. The translucent backdrop-blur pill springs smoothly from one option to the next, giving a glassmorphism selection indicator.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-gravity
items.title: Gravity radio button
items.description: A selection ball falls from above with a gravity arc (ease-in) and multi-bounce settling via CSS keyframes. The ball squishes on landing and leaves a faint impact shadow. Physics-inspired with no library dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-hologram
items.title: Hologram radio button
